metadata.title: Conformome pilot release v0.1.0: conformational-state evidence records for proteins and nucleic acids
metadata.description:
Data release of Conformome (https://conformome.org), an index of experimental and computational evidence on the conformational states of proteins, RNA and DNA. The pilot covers 81 proteins and six nucleic acids (adenine and preQ1 riboswitches, HIV-1 TAR, the Tetrahymena P4-P6 domain, the SARS-CoV-2 frameshifting element and the human telomeric G-quadruplex). Contains all molecule, state, transition, evidence and model records (all-records.jsonl), one JSON bundle per molecule, per-nucleotide reactivity profiles for chemical-probing entries, the JSON Schemas, the technique taxonomy, the per-molecule curation files (states, curator assignments and mapping rules) and the manifest of raw inputs with URLs, retrieval dates and SHA-256 checksums. Evidence from sources whose licence does not permit redistribution is not included and is linked at source. See README.md for file descriptions, identifier schemes and source attributions.

Generated by the Conformome pipeline, version 0.1.0 (software DOI: see related identifiers).
